text:
Dawson Mercer was among the players Winnipeg got back when it sent Connor Hellebuyck to New Jersey on Oct. 23, and three weeks in, the early returns are good. He scored twice against the Devils on Nov. 10, then twice more two nights later in an 8-3 win in Dallas, and the Jets have won six straight.

Our numbers would cool the celebration a little. He has five goals in his last ten games on 2.1 expected goals (the quality of his chances), roughly his normal level of chances, so the finishing is running ahead. Across the full season, both teams included, his five goals on 4.4 expected look about right, and he's playing 15:40 a night. The thing to watch is where his shots come from. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him getting 1.6 shots per 60 off passes across the slot or from behind the net last season, the most dangerous looks there are. On a Winnipeg team with more finishers around him, that's the part of his game worth following.
